symptom: A state-changing connector action targeted the wrong resource and briefly reopened an unrelated GitHub issue.
rootCause: Mutation tool, resource type, exact identifier and requested intent were not matched as a mandatory precondition before dispatch.
knownFailedApproach: Using a mutation to discover or infer resource state or dispatching before resource identity and user intent are exact.
prevention: Before every mutation, verify tool action, resource type, exact identifier and requested intent. Never use a write as discovery. After an accidental mutation, restore the exact prior state and perform one readback.
regressionContract: No state-changing connector call may execute when tool action, resource type, exact identifier or requested intent is unresolved or mismatched.

onAccidentalMutation: add or reuse a prevention rule before retry
recovery.terminalRule: Only verified restored state closes the incident.
